name: Individual Volunteer (Tracy Aviary)
what_you_do: Volunteer at Tracy Aviary. Help with ongoing jobs at the aviary, and meet people who share an interest in birds. Group projects are mostly outdoors.
who_can_apply: Individual volunteers must be at least 15. Younger teens can volunteer with an adult. They fill out the Family Volunteer form.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You get a free annual family membership after 20 volunteer hours.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Individual Volunteer form on the page.
notes: Group service projects for 5 to 25 people are also offered. Court ordered service is for 18 and older only.
